name: WWT Martin Mere Play Areas
description: A big adventure play area by the gift shop with a zip wire, scramble net, treehouse, timber trails and rope bridges (open all year), plus Paddle and Play for little ones, with a rain curtain, a play stream with sluice gates and in-ground trampolines (gated, open until October), and the Wild Walk.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the centre's tickets page for prices. WWT members get in free at all 10 wetland centres.
